Class McpServerDraftBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.commercetools.api.models.mcp_server.McpServerDraftBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
Builder<McpServerDraft>
public class McpServerDraftBuilder extends Object implements Builder<McpServerDraft>
McpServerDraftBuilder
Example to create an instance using the builder pattern 

     McpServerDraft mcpServerDraft = McpServerDraft.builder()
             .key("{key}")
             .mcpServer(mcpServerBuilder -> mcpServerBuilder)
             .build()
